caption: The drawing features a three-dimensional figure of a man dressed in clothes representing the United States flag, including a blue jacket with white stars, red-and-white vertically striped pants, and a tall blue top hat decorated with white stars. The figure is standing on a rectangular box that is red with green trim. The front of the box displays a gold eagle with spread wings and a blue ribbon above it with the words "UNCLE SAM" written in white. At the right side of the box’s front panel, the word "BANK" appears in yellow lettering. Beside the standing figure, an object resembling a brown satchel or bag marked "U.S." is positioned on the top surface of the box. The box appears metallic, with a gray top. The artist's name, "Elmer Weise," is written in small print below the illustration, toward the bottom left area of the page. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional elements or patterns.
title: Toy Bank: Uncle Sam
